title: Croissant with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="g1" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD97A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E8A33D"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="g2" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F5C05E"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D48B2A"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body of croissant -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="38" ry="24" fill="url(#g1)"/>

  <!-- croissant ridges -->
  <path d="M20 48 Q35 38 50 42 Q65 46 72 54" fill="none" stroke="#C97A1E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M24 58 Q38 50 52 53 Q64 56 70 62" fill="none" stroke="#C97A1E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 68 Q40 62 52 64 Q62 66 68 70" fill="none" stroke="#C97A1E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left tip -->
  <ellipse cx="17" cy="50" rx="10" ry="8" fill="url(#g2)" transform="rotate(-25 17 50)"/>
  <!-- right tip -->
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="52" rx="10" ry="8" fill="url(#g2)" transform="rotate(25 83 52)"/>

  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="46" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#FFEFA8" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(-10 42 46)"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="56" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#5A2D0C"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="56" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#5A2D0C"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="54.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E0"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="54.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E0"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 63 Q50 69 56 63" fill="none" stroke="#5A2D0C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="62" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8C8C" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="62" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8C8C" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
